removed.reason: No evidence or description of T1085 behavior in the paragraph; the technique is unspecified and not referenced.
Paragraph describes file/application masquerading (spoofed executable, visa-themed filenames), not masquerading of a task or service.
Mentions using the 'open' shell command for .doc/.pdf files, but this is a shell verb, not the Windows command shell (cmd.exe).
No mention of scheduled tasks or abuse of the Windows Task Scheduler.
